articles.title: Fed Won't Raise Rates at Next Meeting, Strategist Amoroso Says

articles.title: Dubai Builds Up Financial Center With New $1.4 Billion District

articles.title: ADP's Richardson: This Is a Lopsided Economy
articles.summary: ADP Chief Economist and ESG Officer Nela Richardson says the US has a lopsided economy. She says new data shows inflation is running hot while paychecks are not keeping up. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: GTCR, Elliott Acquire Software Firm CCC for $4.6 Billion

articles.title: India’s RBI Clarifies Scope of Forex Curbs After Market Swings
articles.summary: India’s central bank said its recent derivative restrictions will only apply to deals for hedging forex risk and not for market-making, providing a clarification after sharp swings in currency forward markets.

articles.title: NYC Comptroller Calls for Anthropic to Pause IPO for AI Safety

articles.title: Pentagon Intends to Hold Iran School Attack Report Past Midterms

articles.title: Jeff Currie Sees All Oil Market Risks ‘Strictly to the Upside’

articles.title: Carretera amazónica expone el dilema climático de las elecciones en Brasil

articles.title: Trump’s Mineral Stockpile Prepares Up to $1 Billion in Loans
